name: tot
description: TOT — an agent that runs on your own ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions, with a cloud computer per agent, long-term memory, and plugins.

scripts.app:build: npm run build -w @tot/web && tsx build.ts && electron-builder --config builder.config.ts --publish never
scripts.test: NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning sh -c 'TOT_DATA_DIR=$(mktemp -d) tsx desktop.test.ts && TOT_DATA_DIR=$(mktemp -d) tsx updates.test.ts'
